channel.title: Deskpro incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Deskpro's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Deskpro Cloud AI degraded (US hosting region) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been fixed, and AI functionality is now working normally.

item.title: Images and attachments not loading (EU region) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. The cause was an internal change to how our systems renew their access credentials, which left file storage temporarily unreachable. Access was restored automatically at 07:00 UTC and the change has been corrected. Only the EU region was affected. We are sorry for the disruption.

item.title: Potential authentication issues with Google Auth on cloud sites [resolved]
Service disruption during scheduled maintenance [resolved]
item.description: Between 7:30am and 7:44am BST this morning, access to Deskpro was degraded for approximately 14 minutes. The disruption occurred during scheduled infrastructure maintenance, part of our ongoing hardening work following the recent service incident. The maintenance took longer to apply than anticipated. Service was fully restored at 7:44am and all systems are operating normally. No data was lost or affected.

item.title: Intermittent errors and slow performance [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 13:36 and 14:15 BST, some customers experienced errors and slow performance when using Deskpro. This was caused by an issue with one of our database servers. Our team identified the affected server and rerouted traffic away from it, restoring normal performance. We've opened an investigation with our infrastructure provider to determine the root cause.

item.title: Intermittent errors when adding attachments [resolved]
item.description: This issue is now resolved. We have removed the mitigations that were put in place and confirmed normal operation. We'll continue to monitor closely to ensure stability and will provide a further update if anything changes.

item.title: WhatsApp & Meta Social Channels – Agent Replies Not Sending [resolved]
item.description:
The issue has now been resolved.
Agent replies on WhatsApp and Meta social channels are sending as expected.

item.title: Inbound Voice Calls Not Alerting Agents [resolved]
item.description: Inbound call alerting has been restored for all affected customers.

item.title: Degraded performance with search functionality [resolved]
item.description: After monitoring over the weekend, this incident has been resolved.

item.title: Issues at Cloudflare are causing intermittent connectivity problems [resolved]
item.description:
Cloudflare report that the issue has been resolved.
Normal service should be fully restored. If you continue to experience any issues, please reach out to support@deskpro.com.
